propositions: rebar's bedrock provider ignores AWS_REGION environment variable and only consults REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION and AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, causing LLM operations to fail when operators export only AWS_REGION in their shell
botocore does not consult AWS_REGION during region resolution, requiring rebar to implement explicit region resolution at its own layer

resolve_bedrock_region must chain resolution with precedence: REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION > AWS_DEFAULT_REGION > AWS_REGION > profile fallback, and pass the resolved region explicitly to boto3.session.Session
provenance_for must record region and region_source fields for bedrock provider runs when rebar's resolution chain succeeds, and omit both fields when only ambient profile resolution applies
error messages and documentation must be updated to name the full region resolution chain and remove stale guidance about AWS_REGION not being supported
